scripts.copy-apk:dev: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); const path = require('path'); const src = path.join(__dirname, '..', 'android', 'app', 'build', 'outputs', 'apk', 'dev', 'debug', 'app-dev-debug.apk'); const dest = path.join(__dirname, 'public', 'textbee.apk'); if (fs.existsSync(src)) { fs.copyFileSync(src, dest); console.log('Dev APK copied successfully'); } else { console.warn('Dev APK not found, skipping copy'); }"
scripts.copy-apk:prod: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); const path = require('path'); const src = path.join(__dirname, '..', 'android', 'app', 'build', 'outputs', 'apk', 'prod', 'release', 'app-prod-release.apk'); const dest = path.join(__dirname, 'public', 'textbee.apk'); console.log('=== APK Copy Debug Info ==='); console.log('Current directory (__dirname):', __dirname); console.log('Looking for APK at:', src); console.log('APK exists:', fs.existsSync(src)); if (!fs.existsSync(src)) { console.log('Checking parent directories...'); const androidDir = path.join(__dirname, '..', 'android'); console.log('Android directory exists:', fs.existsSync(androidDir)); const apkDir = path.join(__dirname, '..', 'android', 'app', 'build', 'outputs', 'apk'); console.log('APK directory exists:', fs.existsSync(apkDir)); if (fs.existsSync(apkDir)) { const findApk = (dir) => { try { const items = fs.readdirSync(dir, { withFileTypes: true }); items.forEach(item => { const fullPath = path.join(dir, item.name); if (item.isDirectory()) { findApk(fullPath); } else if (item.name.endsWith('.apk')) { console.log('Found APK:', fullPath); } }); } catch (e) {} }; findApk(apkDir); } } if (fs.existsSync(src)) { fs.copyFileSync(src, dest); console.log('Production APK copied successfully from:', src); console.log('To:', dest); } else { console.warn('Production APK not found at expected path'); }"
